purpose: Ollivander invites Harry to try a wand. The first fails. The second lights up the room and the shopkeeper explains why.

music.credit: Constance by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0. Excerpted and mixed.

shots.beat: Harry holds the wand as Ollivander asks him to wave it.
Keep the reaction and the shopkeeper’s dry verdict.
Skip the intermediate trial. Ollivander considers another wand.
The shopkeeper presents the new wand.
Harry takes the wand and light fills the shop.
The shopkeeper’s reaction confirms something has changed.
Ollivander turns the strange result into a rule of the world.
End on Harry hearing that the wand chooses the wizard.
